text: dsh-plugin-openai-api 是面向 DSH Web 的 OpenAI 兼容接口插件，通过挂载 HTTP 路由提供模型列表和聊天补全。它支持普通 JSON 回复与服务器发送事件流式回复，并将每组 API key 与 agent preset 对应到独立的 DSH 会话。客户端可通过 X-Agent-Preset 选择 preset；首次请求导入对话文本，后续请求继续当前会话。适合需要让 OpenAI API 客户端连接 DSH agent 的场景。可选配置 apiKeys、模型、provider 和工作目录；安装后默认禁用，需在 Web profile 中启用。

dsh-plugin-openai-api adds OpenAI-compatible model and chat endpoints to DSH Web. It supports JSON and SSE replies, with sessions separated by key and preset. Clients can continue conversations and choose a preset. It starts disabled; optional settings include keys, model, provider, and cwd.
想让兼容 OpenAI 的客户端连接到 DSH Web 里的 agent。
有没有接口能用 HTTP 请求 DSH 并接收流式聊天回复？
I want an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint backed by a DSH agent.
dsh-plugin-openai-api 的功能「聊天补全」：向 /v1/chat/completions 发送消息，可选择 JSON 或 SSE 流式响应；插件将用户轮次交给 DSH agent 会话并返回助手文本。
dsh-plugin-openai-api 的功能「模型列表」：客户端请求 /v1/models 可取得当前配置的模型 id；聊天请求也可通过 X-Agent-Preset 指定会话使用的 agent preset。
dsh-plugin-openai-api 使用前须知：apiKeys 未配置时接口不要求认证；配置后必须提供匹配的 Bearer key。插件随包默认禁用，需在 Web profile 显式启用。

dsh-plugin-openai-api README · dsh-plugin-openai-api：

An OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a running `dsh web` server: ``` GET /v1/models POST /v1/chat/completions (non-streaming and SSE streaming) ```

dsh-plugin-openai-api README · Installation：Install the plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/openai-api
```

(From a DSH source checkout, the same command is `pnpm dsh plugin …`.
A plain path links the source, so edits are picked up on restart. Fresh
checkout of this repo: recreate `node_modules` first —
`ln -s /path/to/deepseek-harness/apps/cli/node_modules node_modules`.)

Uninstall the plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-openai-api
```

Restart `dsh web` after either.

dsh-plugin-openai-api README · Configuration：Append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` (the install ships
`disabled: true`):

```yaml
- id: openai-api
  disabled: false
  config:
    model: default

The `config` block replaces the plugin's defaults wholesale. Set
`disabled: true` to switch the endpoint off. Restart `dsh web` after
changes. All keys are optional:

dsh-plugin-openai-api README · Configuration：| key | default | what it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `default` | The model id advertised at `/v1/models`. A request's `model` (absent, or this id) → the host's default model selection; any other id is passed through to the session. |
| `provider` | host default | The provider route created sessions use. |
| `apiKeys` | unset (no auth) | Non-empty array of client keys. When set, a request must present one of them (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`), else 401. A key identifies the caller; it does not select the preset. |
| `cwd` | the `dsh web` process's working directory | Working directory for created sessions. Must start with `/`. |

dsh-plugin-openai-api README · Using the API：The contract is OpenAI's — it just works.

```js
import OpenAI from 'openai'

const client = new OpenAI({
  baseURL: 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v1',

The same, without an SDK (the `Bearer` header only when you set
`apiKeys`):

```sh
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer local-key' \
  -H 'X-Agent-Preset: custom-agent-preset' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'

dsh-plugin-openai-api README · `X-Agent-Preset`：The agent preset id the session joins — any id in
`~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`, plus the shipped presets.

- Absent → the default preset (`standard`).
- Unknown id → 400 with the roster; repeated or comma-joined → 400.
- Resolved at session creation only: the same (key, preset) pair always
  resumes the same session; a different value is a different session.
